title_en: Provisions on the Administration of Satellite Television Broadcasting Ground Receiving Facilities

articles.content_en: Article 1 These Provisions are formulated for the purpose of strengthening the administration of satellite television broadcasting ground receiving facilities and promoting the construction of socialist spiritual civilization.

Article 2 For the purpose of these Provisions, the term "satellite television broadcasting ground receiving facilities" (hereinafter referred to as satellite ground receiving facilities) means the antenna, low-noise block downconverter, receiver, encoder, decoder and other facilities used for receiving television programs transmitted by satellites.

Article 3 The State shall implement a licensing system for the production, import, sale, installation and use of satellite ground receiving facilities.
The conditions for the license of production, import, sale, installation and use of satellite ground receiving facilities shall be prescribed by the relevant administrative departments of the State Council.

Article 4 Production enterprises licensed by the competent department of industrial product production licenses shall sell satellite ground receiving facilities to installation service institutions established according to law. No other unit or individual may sell them.

Article 5 The import of satellite ground receiving facilities must be accompanied by a certificate issued by the administrative department of radio and television under the State Council, and the import of special components and parts of satellite ground receiving facilities must be accompanied by a certificate issued by the administrative department of electronic industry under the State Council. The formalities of examination and approval shall be handled with the administrative department of import and export of mechanical and electrical products under the State Council, and the Customs shall release the goods upon the strength of the approved document.
Individuals are prohibited from carrying or mailing satellite ground receiving facilities into the country.

Article 6 The quality certification certificate and certification mark for satellite ground receiving facilities shall be issued by the certification body recognized by the product quality supervision and administration department under the State Council or the department authorized by the said department, after passing the certification in accordance with the provisions of the relevant laws and regulations on quality certification. Without quality certification, no sale or use shall be allowed.

Article 7 A unit that installs satellite ground receiving facilities must file an application with the local administrative department of radio and television of the county or municipal people's government, which shall be submitted to the administrative department of radio and television of the provincial, autonomous regional or municipal people's government for examination and approval. Satellite ground receiving facilities shall be purchased on the strength of the certificate issued by the approving authority. After the completion of installation of satellite ground receiving facilities, the approving authority shall issue a "License for Receiving Television Programs Transmitted by Satellites".

Article 8 Individuals shall not install or use satellite ground receiving facilities.
If there are special circumstances and an individual indeed needs to install and use satellite ground receiving facilities and meets the licensing conditions prescribed by the administrative department of radio and television under the State Council, the individual must file an application with the unit where he or she works, obtain the consent of the local administrative department of radio and television of the county or municipal people's government, and then submit it to the administrative department of radio and television of the provincial, autonomous regional or municipal people's government for examination and approval.

Article 9 Where satellite ground receiving facilities have been installed without approval prior to the promulgation of these Provisions, the formalities for examination and approval must be completed within six months from the date of promulgation of these Provisions in accordance with these Provisions.

Article 10 Whoever violates these Provisions by producing satellite ground receiving facilities without authorization, or where a production enterprise fails to sell them to installation service institutions established according to law as prescribed, the competent department of industrial product production licenses shall order the cessation of production and sale.
Whoever violates these Provisions by selling satellite ground receiving facilities without authorization, the market supervision and administration department shall order the cessation of sale, confiscate the satellite ground receiving facilities, and may also impose a fine of not more than two times the amount of the sales.
Whoever violates these Provisions by installing or using satellite ground receiving facilities without authorization, the administrative department of radio and television shall confiscate the satellite ground receiving facilities installed or used, and may also impose a fine of not more than RMB 5,000 on an individual, or a fine of not more than RMB 50,000 on a unit.

Article 11 A party dissatisfied with a penalty decision may, in accordance with the provisions of relevant laws and administrative regulations, apply for administrative reconsideration or bring an administrative action.

Article 12 The detailed implementation rules for these Provisions shall be formulated by the administrative department of radio and television under the State Council in consultation with the relevant administrative departments.
Article 13 These Provisions shall come into force as of the date of promulgation.
